record_navigation: runs[run].cases[case].{fixture,snapshot,python_fp32} identifies a tensor_sets entry, whose tensor-name values identify tensor_records. Every original SHA and FP64 metric is retained. Profile annotation text is pooled separately; run timing retains all raw rounds and medians.
limitations: The two changes were measured together; overall speedups cannot be attributed to PSF fusion alone.
Deterministic and default algorithm lanes are separate experiments. Original default-lane failures remain failures.
Profiler counts are CPU API events, not kernel launches. Backward worker events can appear in 'other', outside the Python VJP annotation; retain every scope.
The source prepares the PSF FFT first. The first forward fft2 shape and total 2/3 calls establish preservation within this verified source order; no training spectrum cache is introduced.
Full-model hashes cover one synthetic Adam step, not dataset quality or long-term convergence. Timings exclude data loading.
Five measured rounds per run and two independent deterministic pairs produce observed ranges, not confidence intervals or a universal speed guarantee.
